name: The Wired Internet Scheme for Information and Communication Technology Laboratory in Schools in the State of Goa
benefit:
- Monthly rental reimbursement of up to ₹2,000/-.
- The benefit is intended to avail internet service to the respective school's Information and Communication Technology Laboratory.

##### ***Disbursement***

- Financial support will be released to the Head of Government and Government-Aided Schools through the Directorate of Education.
- The Deputy Director Education of each Educational Zone
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a Government School or Government-Aided School in Goa. - The applicant must have a dedicated Information and Communication Technology Laboratory. - The applicant must have at least 03 working Computer Systems in the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Laboratory. - The school must have a minimum student enrolment as prescribed by the Directorate of Education. - The school Information and Communication Technology Laboratory must not have availed of any internet services through any other schemes of the State or Central Government agencies or bodies. ##### ***Required Internet Service Provider/Internet Vendor Conditions*** - The Internet Service Provider/Internet Vendor must provide 50 Megabits per second upload and download speeds at a 1:10 contention ratio and unlimited data through Optical Fibre Connection. - The Internet Service Provider/Internet Vendor must provide a Service Level Agreement for rectification time after a complaint is logged in the Internet Service Provider/Internet Vendor provided portal: Minor Fault (Last mile issue, device issue, etc.) rectification time must be 04 to 08 hours. - The Internet Service Provider/Internet Vendor must provide a Service Level Agreement for rectification time after a complaint is logged in the Internet Service Provider/Internet Vendor provided portal: Major Fault (Major Links Down, Underground cable cut, etc.) rectification time must be 24-48 hours. - The link uptime should be not less than 97.5%. ##### ***Preference*** Priority would be given to remote/rural schools.
